title: A Trail for Early Birds
transcript: A new walking trail will open in Briar Wood next week. The route follows an old railway line for nearly three kilometres, with benches along the way. To protect birds that are building nests, visitors are asked to keep dogs on a lead. Local volunteers will offer free guided walks at dawn on the first two Saturdays. Anyone who wants to join should bring binoculars if they have them. Strong shoes are recommended because parts of the path may be wet.

options: The bank of a large river.
The edge of a town square.
